title: Beyond Silos: Transformative Change for the Caribbean
transcription: Across the Caribbean, environmental pressures are no longer unfolding separately. Climate instability, biodiversity decline, rising food dependence and economic vulnerability increasingly collide, amplifying risks across ecosystems, livelihoods and communities. For small island developing states, the consequences are deeply interconnected. So, from food security right through to spiritual well-being, ability to heal and restore, biodiversity plays a critical role. So, this sector needs to go beyond the symptom, the symptoms of the crisis. We have to go deeper. And these are things that I think the environmental sector has avoided for too long. At the second Caribbean regional trialogue, participants repeatedly returned to one central idea, interconnected crises cannot be solved through isolated action. The discussions challenged traditional approaches that treat biodiversity, climate, food systems and development as separate policy areas. What the nexus assessment did is very different from a lot of the previous assessments. It sought to move away from the piecemeal approaches and the siloed sectoral thinking to looking across different sectors: health, food, climate, biodiversity, to find response options that will deliver multiple co-benefits at scale. The conversations also reinforced that these systems extend beyond national borders. As a region, as a Caribbean, it forces us to contemplate how we treat with our neighbors.

transcription: For over a century, physicists have pushed the boundaries of our understanding, revealing the hidden structures of the world around us. Through these discoveries, we've unlocked the secrets of the tiniest particles and mapped the far reaches of the cosmos. And yet, physics holds a mystery that remains unsolved: the phenomenon of life itself. At Physics of Life, we explore what brings matter to life. title: Towards Calibrating Prompt Tuning of Vision- Language Models - CVPR 2026
transcription: I am presenting our work, towards calibrating prompt tuning of vision-language models. This work focuses on improving the reliability of prompt-tuned CLIP models. Our main goal is not only to improve accuracy, but also to make the model's confidence more trustworthy. Prompt tuning is widely used because it adapts CLIP efficiently without updating the full model. However, most existing methods mainly focus on classification accuracy. In real-world applications, accuracy alone is not enough. A model must also know how confident it should be. If a model gives high confidence to wrong predictions, it becomes risky in areas such as medical imaging, autonomous systems, and safety-critical AI. Therefore, models' predicted confidence should equal to the true likelihood or model predicted accuracy. This will ensure that the model's predicted confidence is calibrated. Post-hoc calibration can adjust confidence after training, but it cannot prevent embedding drift caused during prompt tuning. Our key observation is that prompt tuning creates a dual miscalibration problem. For base classes, the model often becomes underconfident because the logit margins are reduced. For novel classes, the model becomes overconfident because the margins become inflated or unstable. The reliability diagrams and margin analysis show that margin behavior affects base and novel classes differently. Therefore, we need a train-time method that controls both logit margins and text embedding geometry, which preserves CLIP geometry by preventing prompt-induced semantic drift and stabilizes class relations, reducing overconfident wrong predictions, thereby lowering calibration error. To solve this, we propose two complementary losses. First, the mean variance margin loss stabilizes the logit gap between the ground-truth class and the strongest incorrect class. This helps improve confidence separation. Second, the text moment matching loss preserves CLIP's original text embedding geometry by matching the distribution of tuned text embeddings with frozen CLIP embeddings. The total loss combines cross-entropy, margin regularization, and moment matching. Together, they reduce base class underconfidence and novel class overconfidence. Margin loss alone is useful, but it can still create high-confidence wrong predictions, especially on novel classes. This happens because if the model predicts the wrong class, increasing the margin can make that wrong prediction even more confident. Moment matching solves this by preserving semantic geometry. So, margin improves discriminability, while moment matching prevents semantic drift. Their combination gives better calibration, especially for novel classes. We evaluate the method on 11 datasets: ImageNet, Caltech-101, Pets, Cars, Flowers...

title: Towards Calibrating Prompt Tuning of Vision- Language Models - CVPR 2026
transcription: Food 101, Aircraft, Sun 397, DTD, EuroSAT, and UCF 101. We test with major prompt tuning methods such as CoOp, MaPLe, and KgCoOp, CoCoOp, ProDA, ProGrad, and PromptSRC. The main evaluation metrics are accuracy and expected calibration error, or ECE. Lower ECE means better calibration. For base classes, our method consistently reduces ECE while maintaining or slightly improving accuracy. This shows that margin stabilization is effective for reducing underconfidence. For example, in CoOp and MaPLe, our method achieves lower average ECE than vanilla prompt tuning in most calibration baselines. The green highlighted values show that our approach gives strong calibration improvement across datasets. For novel classes, the main challenge is overconfidence. The results show that our method reduces ECE while preserving generalization accuracy. This is important because novel classes are unseen during prompt tuning. Compared with post-hoc methods such as temperature scaling and DAC, our train-time regularization better prevents semantic drift and gives more reliable confidence estimates. In the loss component study, combining margin loss with moment matching gives the best calibration. The MBLS comparison shows that our margin regularization is more effective because it lifts low margin samples instead of only limiting extreme margins. The distribution shift results also show that our method remains stable under both base and novel class settings. We also test the method on medical modality datasets. This is important because calibration is especially critical in medical AI. A wrong prediction with high confidence can be dangerous. The results show that our method improves calibration in medical settings as well, confirming that the approach is not limited to natural image datasets. While ECE is the main metric, we also evaluate other calibration metrics. The results on base and novel classes show that our method remains competitive across different calibration measurements. This strengthens the claim that the improvement is not only specific to one metric, but reflects more reliable confidence behavior overall. To conclude, prompt tuning causes two different calibration problems: underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes by semantic drift on the CLIP geometry. Our method addresses both by stabilizing logit margins and preserving CLIP's text embedding geometry. It is plug-and-play, requires no architectural change, and adds no extra inference cost. Overall, our method improves calibration without sacrificing accuracy, making prompt-tuned vision-language models more reliable for real-world deployment.

title: Investigative Journalist Tom O'Neill on CIA's MKUltra Mind-Control Program
transcription: Almost 50 years ago, the last congressional hearings into MK-Ultra took place just a short walk from here in the Dirksen Senate Office Building. At those hearings convened in August and September of 1977, representatives of the CIA told Congress and the American people that its 25-year effort to control human behavior had been a colossal failure. Because I believe Congress was never told the truth about what this program actually achieved. In fact, I believe the agency misled Congress in 1977 when it characterized MK-Ultra as a failure. My name is Tom O'Neill and in 1999, I was accepted, I accepted a magazine assignment to write a story about murders committed by a group of hippies called the Manson family. For those unfamiliar with this horrific episode of American history, in the summer of 1969, four young people acting on the orders of a cult leader named Charles Manson went to the home of movie director Roman Polanski and murdered everyone they found there, including his eight-and-a-half-month pregnant wife, the actress Sharon Tate. The victims were complete strangers to the, to their killers. The following night, Manson's followers murdered another couple in the same grisly fashion. At the time I accepted the assignment, I had never heard of MK-Ultra, and I wouldn't for another two years, after I'd missed countless deadlines, lost the assignment, and fallen down a nightmarish rabbit hole trying to answer the question I couldn't quite shake. How had Manson, a barely literate ex-con, acquired the ability to persuade ordinary young people to murder complete strangers simply because he had told them to? The pursuit of that answer, the pursuit of the answer to that question led me to Dr. Louis Jolyon West, known to his friends as Jolly. West was one of the most influential psychiatrists in America. During his career, he crossed paths with some of the most controversial events of the 20th century, including the Patty Hearst kidnapping case and the aftermath of the John F. Kennedy assassination investigation.

title: Investigative Journalist Tom O'Neill on CIA's MKUltra Mind-Control Program
transcription: In 1977, West was one of seven academic researchers named in a front-page New York Times story alleging that the CIA had used American universities, hospitals, and prisons as secret laboratories for experiments involving LSD and other drugs on unwitting human subjects. West vigorously denied the allegations. He acknowledged that the agency had approached him, but insisted he had refused because he said LSD was too dangerous and unpredictable to be used on humans. He added that he limited all of his research with LSD to animals. The revelations in the Times led directly to the congressional hearings held later that year. West's denials, however, were effective. He was never investigated, and his name never came up at the hearings. I'll spare you the long and tedious story of how my Manson reporting led to West—led me to West, except to say that I eventually learned that in 1967, when Manson transformed into the cult leader we are familiar with today, he and his followers were receiving free medical care at a clinic in San Francisco where West had established a base of operations for a research project he was conducting nearby. After becoming intrigued by the allegations against West, I learned that UCLA, his last academic home, had inherited his papers following his death in 1999. Nearly two months and more than 200 boxes later, I found the proverbial needle in a haystack: correspondence between West and Dr. Sidney Gottlieb, the architect of MKUltra. The letters begin in 1953, just two months after CIA Director Allen Dulles authorized the program, and while West was stationed at the Lackland Air Force Base in San Antonio, Texas, where he was chief—chief psychiatrist at the base hospital. In his first letter to Gottlieb, West proposed conducting experiments on unwitting human subjects, including military personnel, prisoners, and psychiatric patients at the base hospital.

transcription: He then outlined the experiments themselves in six more pages that could have been written by Josef Mengele. Using LSD in combination with hypnosis, West proposed inducing confusion, amnesia, and specific mental disorders in people who would remember nothing of their interaction with him afterward. He sought to develop techniques to extract true information and implant false information in unwilling subjects and to alter the attitudes and beliefs of, quote, "previously loyal individuals." In other words, to completely switch their allegiance from one group or leader to another. But it was that sentence—but it was another sentence at the end of that letter that stopped me cold. "These experiments," he wrote, "must eventually be put to test in practical trials in the field." Gottlieb's response could hardly have been more enthusiastic. "My good friend," he wrote, "I had been wondering whether your apparent, rapid, and comprehensive grasp of our problems could possibly be real. You have indeed developed an admirably accurate picture of exactly what we are after." West replied that there was no more vital undertaking conceivable in these times. There was another document in West's papers that had even more significant implications. It was a 14-page report that West wrote in 1956, just three years after he contracted with the CIA. In the report, West described administering LSD and other drugs in conjunction with hypnosis on unwitting human subjects, and then he made a remarkable claim. He announced that he had learned how to replace true memories with false memories in people without their knowledge. In other words, he clarified, "it has been found to be feasible to take the memory of a definite event in the life of an individual and, through hypnotic suggestion, bring about the subsequent conscious recall to the effect that this event never actually took place but that a different, fictional event actually did occur." If West's report was accurate, this was not the failure agency officials described in 1977, quite the opposite.

transcription: It was, in fact, the central ambition of the MKUltra operation, the means of gaining the ability to seize the control of a person's perceptions, memories, and ultimately, their behavior. But there was still one more discovery and this time I found it in the National Security Archives at George Washington University, the official repository of the CIA's MKUltra records, which were released to Congress after the 1977 hearings. In those holdings was a different versions of West's 1956 report. The original paper had been replaced by a four-page summary that did not exist in West's files and appears to have been written by someone else. His claims about replacing memories were gone, in their place was a theoretical discussion of LSD and dissociative states. The version supplied to Congress concluded that the effects of LSD and similar drugs on dissociative states had, and I'm quoting, "never been studied." "Never been studied." In the original report, West discusses observations from his own experiments including detailed descriptions of using LSD to, as he wrote, "speed the induction of the hypnotic state and deepen the trance in subjects." Those passages have been removed in the report turned over to Congress. The discrepancy could not have been more stark. Nearly 50 years ago, another congressional committee believed that it had been given the truth about MKUltra, it had not. In conclusion, I respectfully submit that these records, some newly available and others that remained outside the government's disclosure for decades, warrant a thorough reexamination of what the program accomplished, what Congress was told, and what may still remain hidden. I'm happy to provide the documents I've referenced today and I've provided many additional details in my written testimony.

title: Investigation reveals DOJ withheld Epstein files mentioning Trump
transcription: A new NPR investigation reveals the Justice Department withheld portions of the Jeffrey Epstein files that contain allegations involving President Trump, including material tied to claims that Mr. Trump sexually abused a minor, and that some pages mentioning him were removed from the public record. Democrats on the House Oversight Committee called that out today, saying the DOJ's withholding of information could amount to a crime. For more on that and the surrounding fallout, we're joined now by Julie K. Brown, investigative reporter for the Miami Herald, whose reporting helped expose much of the Epstein network. Julie, welcome back to the program. It's great to have you. Thank you. I want to start with this NPR reporting that the Justice Department withheld some Epstein files related to allegations that President Trump sexually abused a minor, which we should say the White House denies. What stands out to you about this? Well, I think what stands out is that we don't have the reports, even though we know they exist. This stems from an interview that they conducted that came out of a tip to the FBI about this woman who has said that she, when she was 13, that she was sexually assaulted by Donald Trump. Now, her one of her interviews is contained in the Epstein files, although it is heavily redacted so it's hard to know exactly what she told the FBI. But as a result of that, we were able to see some of the the report numbers and the Bates stamps on it. And an independent journalist, actually named Roger Sollenberger, was the person that real that found out that compared that number to the documents that the Southern District of New York prosecutors gave to Ghislaine Maxwell's lawyers as part of her criminal case. You broke this story 8 years ago with your investigative reporting. With the benefit of time and hindsight, what do you see more clearly now about how power insulated Jeffrey Epstein, and how much of that protective structure still exists?

title: Nolan Wells' death: FBI probes threats
transcription: Welcome back. The FBI is investigating threats against the people who were with Nolan Wells in the hours before the Mississippi teen vanished and was found dead. Wells, 18, disappeared July 4th after joining friends on a boat trip to Horn Island, a barrier island off Mississippi's Gulf Coast. Search crews scoured the area for two days before a National Park Service Ranger found his remains on the island's northwestern tip on July 6th. Wells' friends returned to the mainland that July afternoon without him, but Jackson County Sheriff John Ledbetter previously said investigators believed Wells chose to stay on the island. It wasn't until later that night that his mother learned that he was missing from one of Wells' friends and reported it to authorities. Mississippi's Department of Public Safety Commissioner Sean Tindell said Wednesday that the FBI is investigating threats made against public officials, the people who were with Wells before he vanished, and their families. Michelle Thomas is now joining us here on LiveNOW from FOX. Michelle, thank you so much for taking the time to talk with us. Thanks so much for having me. So, we talk about this case. The FBI is now investigating threats connected to the case. So, what kind of threats can become federal crimes, and why would the FBI get involved here? Well, anytime there's a threat regarding anyone's person, placing them in immediate harm, there's going to be an investigation. But here, they may also be looking for racially charged threats, given sort of the backdrop of what we've heard about in the public scrutiny, in the public eye, and with the backdrop in history of Mississippi. People are concerned about this case because of sort of the racial makeup and so forth. So, if there are any kind of threats along those lines, there's going to be an investigation, and possibly a federal one. And when we talk about authorities, you know, saying that witnesses, public officials, even family members have received some type of threat here or there, how can that affect an active criminal investigation that can be happening? Well, any kind of law enforcement is going to follow any leads and they're going to try to track any any type of threat because they don't want there to be either witness intimidation or witness coercion. They want to make sure that they're able to preserve the evidence and witness testimony, and that persons with knowledge are able to come forward without feeling fearful. So, it can taint an investigation, and possibly a forthcoming trial, if there are constant threats and people are afraid to come forward with the information needed to solve what happened to Nolan Wells.

title: 'GOBSMACKED': Nicolle reacts to BOMBSHELL new report about Trump family's brazen self-dealing
transcription: Each deeply reported account of self-dealing from the Trump White House seems to get more brazen than the one that came before it. The New York Times has now reviewed a number of federal filings and is out with an extraordinary piece of investigative reporting that details the latest way that Donald Trump's family and allies appear to be profiting off Donald Trump's policy decisions as president. It involves a billion-dollar mining deal with Kazakhstan and one that both Trump and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's sons stand to profit from. In a meeting last September, Donald Trump and Howard Lutnick secured a deal with the leader of Kazakhstan to give a little-known American company now called Kaz Resources access to one of the world's largest untapped reserves of tungsten. It's a crucial rare earth mineral. Here's where the apparent self-dealing comes in, according to the New York Times. Weeks after that meeting, quote, "investors with a firm called Dominari Securities, which is housed at Trump Tower in New York and partly owned by the president's two eldest sons, Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, joined with other partners to take a 20% stake in the corporate entity related to the Kazakhstan project." Around the same time, Cantor Fitzgerald, an investment company controlled by Howard Lutnick's family and overseen by his sons Brandon and Kyle Lutnick, helped one of the lead investors working with Dominari on the Kazakh deal raise $210 million in new capital for a related entity. Such rounds of fundraising typically net Cantor millions of dollars in fees. The deal was, quote, "ultimately signed on November 6th, six days after the investment involving the Trump sons and their partners, which was not publicly disclosed at the time." As the New York Times reports, this continues a pattern of self-enrichment in the Trump administration that has few precedents in American history. When asked for statements, both the White House and the Commerce Department rejected any suggestion that the Trump administration was improperly mixing government actions with family business. Trump's sons both denied being involved in the specifics of the deal. Eric Trump claimed they were passive investors. A Cantor Fitzgerald spokesperson said that company's executives were not involved in discussions related to government funding.

පූජිත් ජයසුන්දරට විශේෂ ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණය මරණ දඩුවම නියම කළා. නඩුව විභාගයට ගැනුනේ ප්‍රියන්ත ලියනගේ, තිලකරත්න බණ්ඩාර සහ විරාජ් වීරසූරිය යන විශේෂ ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණ විනිසුරුවරුන් හමුවේ. සභාපති විනිසුරු ප්‍රියන්ත ලියනගේ සහ තිලකරත්න බණ්ඩාර යන විනිසුරුවරුන් මෙහිදී පූජිත් ජයසුන්දර වරදකරු බවට තීන්දු කළ අතර විරාජ් වීරසූරිය විනිසුරුවරයාගේ තීන්දුව වූයේ අදාළ චෝදනා සාධාරණ සැකයෙන් ඔබ්බට ඔප්පු කිරීමට අසමත් බවයි. විනිසුරු මඩුල්ලේ බහුතර තීන්දුව අනුව චෝදනා 855කින් 854කට හිටපු පොලිස්පති පූජිත් ජයසුන්දර වරදකරු බවට තීන්දු කෙරුණා. හිටපු ආරක්ෂක ලේකම් හේමසිරි ප්‍රනාන්දු සම්බන්ධ තීන්දුවද ප්‍රකාශයට පත් කිරීමට නියමිතයි. ජෙෆ්රි. ස්තූතියි ඔමායා. விசேட செய்தி ஊடாக உங்கள் அனைவரையும் நாங்கள் நேரடியாகச் சந்திக்கிறோம். உயிர்த்த ஞாயிறு தாக்குதல் தொடர்பில் கடமையைத் தவறியதால் ஏற்பட்ட உயிரிழப்புகளுக்குக் காரணமாக அமைந்தமை தொடர்பில் சுமத்தப்பட்ட குற்றச்சாட்டுக்களுக்கு முன்னாள் பொலிஸ் மா அதிபர் பூஜித் ஜயசுந்தரவுக்கு விசேட மூவரடங்கிய மேல் நீதிமன்றத்தினால் மரண தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறது. பிரியந்த transcription: மூவர் அடங்கிய மேல் நீதிமன்றத்தினால் மரண தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறது. ඔව්, අ... ජෙෆ්රි. මේ අවස්ථාවේදී අපි... අපේ අධිකරණ වාර්තාකාරිණී අමෝදා ජයමහ සූදානමින්... පවතින තත්ත්වය සහ මෙම, අ... විශේෂ ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණ දඬුවම පිළිබඳව තොරතුරු ගෙනෙන්න. අමෝදා, ඔබගේ... ඔබට අවස්ථාව. අමෝදා? අමෝදා? හෙලෝ. ඔව් අමෝදා, ඔබව හොඳට ඇහෙනවා අපිට. ඔව් ඔමායා, මා මේ අවස්ථාවේදී රැඳී සිටින්නේ කොළඹ ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණ පරිශ්‍රයේ. මීට සුළු වේලාවකට ප්‍රථමයෙන් පාස්කු ඉරිදා ත්‍රස්ත ප්‍රහාරය එල්ල වීමට නියමිත බුද්ධි තොරතුරු ලැබී තිබියදී, එය වළක්වා ගැනීමට කටයුතු නොකිරීමෙන් 2019 අප්‍රේල් 21 වෙනිදා පාස්කු ප්‍රහාරයට ලක්ව ජීවිත අහිමි වූ ඒ වින්දිතයින්ගේ ජීවිත අහිමි කිරීමට සිය රාජකාරී වගකීම පැහැර හැරීමෙන් ආධාර අනුබල දීමේ චෝදනාවට වරදකරු වූ හිටපු පොලිස්පති පූජිත් ජයසුන්දරට මරණ දඬුවම ලබාදීමට ස්ථිර ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණ විනිසුරු මඬුල්ල තීන්දුවක් ලබා දුන්නා. මෙම තීන්දුව බෙදුණු තීන්දුවක් ලෙස ලබා දුන් අතර සභාපති විනිසුරු ප්‍රියන්ත ලියනගේ සහ විනිසුරු තිළිණ ගමගේ ඒකමතික තීන්දුවෙන් පූජිත් ජයසුන්දර චෝදනා 855කින් 854කට වරදකරු කරමින් මෙම මරණීය දණ්ඩනය ලබා දුන් අතර, ඊට සුළුතර තීන්දුවක් ලබා දුන් විනිසුරු විරාජ් ජයසූරිය සාධාරණ සැකයෙන් ඔබ්බට චූදිතට එරෙහිව පැමිණිල්ල චෝදනා ඔප්පු කර නැති බැවින් විත්තිකරු වරදවලින් නිදහස් කරන බව පැවසුවා. ඒ අනුව වසර හතර, හතකට පසුව අද දින මෙම විභාගය අවසන් කරමින් තීන්දුව ලබාදෙමින්, පාස්කු ප්‍රහාරයේ වින්දිතයින්ගේ මරණයන්ට සිය රාජකාරි වගකීම පැහැර හැරීමෙන් ආධාර අනුබල ලබා දුන් බවට පොලිස්පති පූජිත් ජයසුන්දරට මරණීය දණ්ඩනය ලබා දුන්නා. මම නිවුස් ෆස්ට් වෙනුවෙන් අමෝදා ජයමහ, කොළඹ ස්ථිර ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණ පරිශ්‍රයේ සිට. හොඳයි අමෝදා, බොහොම ස්තූතියි. ඒ අනුව පාස්කු ඉරිදා දින ත්‍රස්ත ප්‍රහාරය සම්බන්ධව රාජකාරී වගකීම පැහැර හරිමින් මරණ සිදුවීමට ආධාර අනුබලදීමේ චෝදනාවට වරදකරු බවට පත්කළ හිටපු පොලිස්පති පූජිත් ජයසුන්දරට විශේෂ ත්‍රිපුද්ගල මහාධිකරණය මරණ දඬුවම නියම කර තිබෙනවා, ජෙෆ්රි. ஆம், ஒமாயா. நாங்கள் விசேட செய்தி உங்களுக்கு வழங்கியிருந்தோம். உயிர்த்த ஞாயிறு தாக்குதல் தொடர்பில் கடமையைத் தவறியதால் ஏற்பட்ட உயிரிழப்புகளுக்கு காரணமாக அமைந்தமை தொடர்பில் சுமத்தப்பட்ட குற்றச்சாட்டுகளுக்கு முன்னாள் பொலிஸ் மா அதிபர் பூஜித் ஜயசுந்தரவுக்கு விசேட மூவரடங்கிய மேல் நீதிமன்றத்தினால் மரண தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறது.

title: Breaking News | හිටපු පොලිස්පති පූජිත් ජයසුන්දරට මරණ දඬුවම   31.07.2026
transcription: இருக்கிறது. பிரியந்த லியனகே, திலகரத்ன பண்டார, விராஜ் வீரசூரிய ஆகிய விசேட மூவரடங்கிய மேல் நீதிமன்ற நீதிபதிகளால் இந்த தீர்ப்பு வழங்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறது. பிரியந்த லியனகே மற்றும் திலகரத்ன பண்டார ஆகிய நீதிபதிகள் பூஜீத் ஜயசுந்தர குற்றவாளி என அறிவித்தார்கள். அதேபோன்று இந்த குற்றச்சாட்டுகள் சாதாரண சந்தேகத்துக்கு அப்பால் நிரூபிக்கப்படவில்லை என விராஜ் வீரசூரிய தனது தீர்ப்பில் அறிவித்திருந்தார். நீதிபதிகள் குழாமின் பெரும்பான்மையுடன் 855 குற்றச்சாட்டுகளில் 854 குற்றச்சாட்டுகளுக்கு முன்னாள் பொலிஸ் மா அதிபர் பூஜீத் ஜயசுந்தர குற்றவாளியாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறார். அதேபோன்று முன்னாள் பாதுகாப்பு செயலாளர் ஹேமசிறி பெர்னாண்டோ தொடர்பான தீர்ப்பு இன்னும் சொற்ப வேளையில் அறிவிக்கப்படவிருக்கிறது. அந்த விசேட செய்தியினை மீண்டும் அறியத் தருகிறோம். உயிர்த்த ஞாயிறு தாக்குதல் தொடர்பில் கடமையை தவறியதால் ஏற்பட்ட உயிரிழப்புகளுக்கு காரணமாக அமைந்தமை தொடர்பில் சுமத்தப்பட்ட குற்றச்சாட்டுகளுக்கு முன்னாள் பொலிஸ் மா அதிபர் பூஜீத் ஜயசுந்தரவிற்கு விசேட மூவரடங்கிய மேல் நீதிமன்றத்தினால் மரண भाई यानी Redmi Note 17 Pro भी लॉन्च होगा जिसके रीब्रांडिंग में Poco का X8 देखने को मिलने वाला है और इन दोनों फोन की प्राइसिंग लगभग 30,000 के आसपास रहने वाली है। वैसे अगर लॉन्च डेट की बात की जाए, तो ये चारों ही फोन आपको अगस्त के एंड में देखने को मिल सकता है। दोस्तों, ओप्पो की तरफ से भी एक परफॉर्मेंस सेंट्रिक फोन लॉन्च होने वाला है जिसका नाम है Oppo K15। ये फोन गेमर्स लोगों को ज्यादा टारगेट करेगा और ये Oppo K13 का सक्सेसर होगा। इसमें आपको 6.59 इंचेस का 1.5K LTPO AMOLED डिस्प्ले मिलेगा जो कि 120Hz की रिफ्रेश रेट और 1200 निट्स की पीक ब्राइटनेस को सपोर्ट करता है। बाकी परफॉर्मेंस के लिए मीडियाटेक डाइमेंसिटी का 7360 वाला चिपसेट, 8000mAh की बड़ी बैटरी प्लस 80W वायर्ड फ़ास्ट चार्जिंग और 50 मेगापिक्सल का डुअल कैमरा सेटअप मिलेगा। इसके अलावा, Oppo K13 के जैसे इसमें भी कूलिंग फैन और बाईपास चार्जिंग जैसे फीचर्स भी मिल जाएगी। एक्सपेक्टेड प्राइसिंग और लॉन्च डेट की बात करें तो ये फोन आपको मिड अगस्त में 33,999 टू 36,999 में देखने को मिल जाएगा। इसी के साथ दोस्तों, सैमसंग भी पीछे नहीं रहने वाला क्योंकि वो अपने Samsung F70 Pro को लॉन्च करने जा रहा है जिसमें आपको 120Hz वाला फुल एचडी प्लस सुपर एमोलेड डिस्प्ले मिलेगा लेकिन रूमर्स के अकॉर्डिंग ये वॉटर ड्रॉप नॉच डिस्प्ले हो सकता है जो कि आपको पता ही है कि कितना आउटडेटेड लगता है। बाकी परफॉर्मेंस के लिए क्वालकॉम स्नैपड्रैगन का 6 Gen 3 वाला चिपसेट, बैक में ट्रिपल कैमरा सेटअप जिसका मेन सेंसर 50 मेगापिक्सल विथ ओआईएस वाला होगा और 12 मेगापिक्सल का सेल्फी सेंसर मिलेगा। साथ ही 6000mAh की बड़ी बैटरी और 45W का फ़ास्ट चार्जिंग सपोर्ट भी मिल जाएगा। एक्सपेक्टेड है कि ये फोन अगस्त की स्टार्टिंग में आपको 27 से 32 हजार के बीच देखने को मिल सकता है। वैसे दोस्तों, अभी के टाइम पे जो बेस्ट स्मार्टफोंस हैं उन्हें मैंने नीचे प्रोडक्ट सेक्शन में टैग कर दिया है। आप एक बार चेक आउट कर लेना। इसके बाद आईक्यू की तरफ से भी दो स्मार्टफोन लॉन्च होने वाले हैं जिसमें हैं iQOO transcription: अगर आप अप्लाई कर रहे हैं जॉब के लिए गाइस तो कोई भी फीस पे करने की आपको जरूरत नहीं है बिल्कुल निशुल्क आपको अप्लाई करना होगा चाहे किसी भी कैटेगरी या सिटी से अप्लाई कर रहे हो। और सिलेक्शन का जो प्रोसेस है गाइस यहां पर कोई भी एग्जाम नहीं होगा ना ही कोई आपका इंटरव्यू होगा डायरेक्ट यहां पर सिलेक्शन रखा गया है। आप सभी जो है सीधा सिलेक्शन यहां पर पा सकते हैं जस्ट आपको अप्लाई करना है। क्वालिफिकेशन में आप सभी क्वालिफाइड कैंडिडेट्स के लिए जॉब है। और यहां पर अगर आप अप्लाई कर रहे हैं गाइस तो ध्यान रखिएगा इन तमाम दस्तावेजों को तैयार रखिएगा इन्हीं के माध्यम से अप्लाई करना है वरना आपको ये जॉब नहीं मिल पाएगी आपका फॉर्म रिजेक्ट हो सकता है। सबसे पहले तो आपका रिज्यूम है आपका सीवी यानी कि आपका बायोडाटा ठीक है उसे आपको अपडेट करना है फिर अपलोड करना है। अपडेट करने से पहले जो भी जानकारी है आपकी आप ध्यान रखिएगा जैसा कि आपका नाम पिताजी का नाम माताजी का नाम आपकी डेट ऑफ बर्थ आपकी जो भी क्वालिफिकेशन है कहां से आपने पास आउट की है 10वीं से लेकर के हाईएस्ट जो भी क्वालिफिकेशन आपकी है वो आपको मेंशन करनी है। आपके पास अगर कोई एक्सपीरियंस है किसी भी फील्ड का किसी भी आर्गेनाईजेशन का किसी भी अ डेसिग्नेशन का तो आप जो है वहां पर मेंशन कर सकते हैं अदरवाइस आप उसे खाली छोड़ सकते हैं ठीक है? title: Wing Work From Home Jobs 2026 | Part Time Job | Online Job at Home | Verified WFH 12th Pass Jobs
transcription: लें लेकिन अगर आपको बंगाली भी आती है, मराठी आती है, तमिल आती है, तेलुगु, कन्नड़ा, अह गुजराती, पंजाबी और मलयालम इनमें से कोई भी अदर लैंग्वेज भी अगर आपको आती है तो भी आप अप्लाई कर सकते हैं। बट अगर आपको इनमें से कोई भी अदर लैंग्वेज नहीं आती है, अगर आपको केवल हिंदी आती है तब भी आप अप्लाई कर सकते हैं और अगर आपको गाइस इंग्लिश आती है तब भी आप जो है अप्लाई कर सकते हैं। ठीक है? यहाँ पर आपको बता रखा है किस प्रकार की ये जॉब रहने वाली है। आपको अगर ये जॉब मिल जाती है तो क्या करना होगा। ठीक है? तो यहाँ पर आप चेक आउट कर सकते हैं, Complete Short Voice Recording और Conversation, ठीक है? टास्क फॉर एआई ट्रेनिंग पर्पस। ठीक है? तो यहाँ पर सब कुछ आपको बता रखा है कि किस प्रकार आपको यहाँ पर काम करना है, किस प्रकार की जॉब आपकी होने वाली है। यहाँ पर हमने आपको बता ही दिया है कौन-कौन सी लैंग्वेज यहाँ पर रिक्वायर्ड है। उसके साथ ही साथ अगर आप अप्लाई कर रहे हैं तो इंटरनेट कनेक्शन आपके पास होना चाहिए, माइक्रोफोन होना चाहिए, ठीक है? तो यहाँ पर सब कुछ आपको बता रखा है। अगर आपके पास सिस्टम है तो आप अप्लाई कर सकते हैं। और यहाँ पर आप चेक आउट कर सकते हैं किस प्रकार यहाँ पर ये जॉब रहने वाली है, फ्रीलांसर टाइप की जॉब है और पार्ट-टाइम जॉब आप कर सकते हैं। अब गाइस, इस जॉब के लिए आपको कंपनसेशन कितना मिलेगा? स्टूडेंट का सिलेक्शन हुआ है जिनको पहले कहीं से भी रिवर्ट नहीं आ रहा था, इंटरव्यू कॉल नहीं आ रहा था बट फाइनली 21 दिन की ट्रेनिंग के अंदर-अंदर ही इनको यहां पे जॉब मिल गई और सबसे अच्छी बात वर्क फ्रॉम होम का प्रोसेस मिल गया है और गाइज़, ऐसे और बहुत सारे सैकड़ों बच्चों के सिलेक्शन की सक्सेस स्टोरी भी मैं मेरे इस यूट्यूब चैनल पे शेयर कर चुका हूं जिनको पहले कहीं से भी रिप्लाई नहीं आ रहे थे इंटरव्यू के लिए, बट फाइनली वो बच्चे प्लेस हो गए और ज़्यादातर को तो वर्क फ्रॉम होम का ही प्रोसेस मिल गया है। तो एज़ इट इज़ गाइज़, अगर आप लोगों को भी जॉब्स लेने में कहीं पे कोई दिक्कत आ रही है, आपको इंटरव्यू कॉल नहीं आता, आपका रिज़्यूमे शॉर्टलिस्ट और आपको कम्युनिकेशन में दिक्कत है, आप भी हमारी आस्मा करियर की इस 21 दिन की ऑनलाइन जॉब रेडी ट्रेनिंग का पार्ट बन सकते हो जहां पे हम बच्चों को इस ट्रेनिंग में सारी स्किल्स सिखाते हैं ऑनलाइन और उनके इंटरव्यू भी कराते हैं कंपनीज़ में। आप 12वीं पास हैं, आपकी कम्युनिकेशन एवरेज है, आप हमारी ट्रेनिंग का पार्ट बन सकते हो। इसके लिए मैंने डिस्क्रिप्शन में डिटेल दी है। आप हमारी टीम से भी बात कर सकते हो। तो जॉब के ऊपर ही दुबारा से चलते हैं। तो बेसिकली गाइज़, यहां पे जो टेलीपरफॉर्मेंस कंपनी है उसके अंडर ये जॉब वैकेंसी आई है इस प्रोसेस की और सबसे अच्छी बात फ्रेशर, एक्सपीरियंस यहां पे एलिजिबल हैं। कंपनी के रिक्रूटर भी बहुत एक्टिवली रिस्पॉन्ड कर रहे हैं और इस जॉब वैकेंसी के अंदर गाइज़ आपकी कोई भी फीस नहीं लगेगी। ये एकदम जेन्युइन एंड वेरीफाइड जॉब है एंड इस चैनल पे मैं डेली सुबह-शाम गाइज़ ऐसी अमेजिंग वर्क फ्रॉम होम की वीडियोस को पोस्ट कर रहा हूँ। बहुत लोगों को रिवर्ट भी आ रहे हैं, इसलिए इस यूट्यूब चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करके रखो ताकि ऐसी कोई जॉब अपडेट आपसे मिस ना हो और ये वीडियो गाइज़ प्योरली एजुकेशन पर्पस के लिए बनाया गया है। जितने भी इंफॉर्मेशन मैं यहाँ पे आपको दूंगा, ये सारी इंफॉर्मेशन ऑफिशियल सोर्सेज से ली गई है, आप इसको खुद भी चेक कर सकते हो। तो आज की वीडियो में इस जॉब वैकेंसी की पूरी डिटेल डिस्कस करेंगे, ध्यान से आप लोग समझना। चलिए शुरू करते हैं। तो गाइज़, आप लोग जो मेरी स्क्रीन पे देख पा रहे हो ये Naukri.com पे कंपनी का ऑफिशियल पेज है जहां पे ये जॉब वैकेंसी आई transcription: और इस कंपनी की तरफ से जो ऑफिशियल जो वेकेंसी आई है, दैट इस कस्टमर सपोर्ट एग्जीक्यूटिव वोइस प्रोसेस। सबसे पहली बात इस जो वेकेंसी के अंदर आपकी कोई भी फीस नहीं लगेगी। ये एकदम जेन्युइन एंड वैरीफाइड जॉब है और अब आप इस जॉब की डिटेल ओपन कर लेते हैं, ताकि आपको इजीली समझ में आए की एग्जैक्टली यहाँ पे करना क्या रहेगा। तो देखो यार यहाँ से शुरुआत होती है इसकी। अब देखो यहाँ पे लिखा है कस्टमर सपोर्ट एसोसिएट और यहाँ पे प्रोसेस के बारे में भी लिखा हुआ है। एंड सबसे पहली बात ये वर्क फ्रॉम होम की जॉब है, तो आपको घर से काम करना है और इसके अंदर आपकी कोई फीस नहीं लगेगी। एकदम जेन्युइन एंड वैरीफाइड जॉब है। अब इसमें ये अगर अपन यहाँ पे बात करें तो काम क्या है? तो ये जो ई-कॉमर्स का प्रोसेस यहाँ पे आया है, आपका काम है इनके जो कस्टमर्स हैं, वो क्वेरीज आपको सॉल्व करनी है। कोई आर्डर से रिलेटेड हो सकता है, किसी भी चीज से रिलेटेड वो क्वेरी हो सकती है। तो वो क्वेरीज आपको हैंडल करनी है। इसके लिए कंपनी आपको प्रॉपर ट्रेनिंग भी प्रोवाइड कराती है। वोइस प्रोसेस है यानी कि सारा का सारा काम आपका कॉल पे रहेगा। अब कुछ और चीजों के बारे में बात करें, एलिजिबिलिटी ये है कि आप कम से कम ग्रेजुएट यहाँ पे होने चाहिए। फ्रेशर एक्सपीरियंस दोनों चलेंगे, कम्यूनिकेशन अच्छी हो इंग्लिश हिंदी के अंदर और कस्टमर सर्विस ओरिएंटेड माइंडसेट आपका होना चाहिए। आप रोटेशनल शिफ्ट में काम करने में कंफर्टेबल होने चाहिए। क्योंकि इसमें आपको हफ्ते में छह दिन काम करना है। एक दिन आपकी छुट्टी रहेगी, जो छह दिन आपको काम करना है, वो शिफ्ट भी रोटेशनल है। मॉर्निंग, आफ्टरनून, इवनिंग, नाइट ऐसी कोई भी शिफ्ट हो सकती है और एक दिन जो छुट्टी वाला है, वो भी रोटेशनल है। नौ घंटे की शिफ्ट होती है, जिसमें आठ घंटे वर्किंग होता है, एक घंटे का ब्रेक होता है इसके अंदर। एंड बाकी कुछ और चीजों के बारे में बात करें, देखो इसमें काम करने के लिए आपके पास कंप्यूटर सिस्टम होना चाहिए, लैपटॉप, जिसमें i5 प्रोसेसर हो, कम से कम 8GB रैम हो और वेबकैम हो, इंटरनेट कनेक्शन हो, USB हेडसेट हो, पावर बैकअप हो। अगर ये सब कुछ है तो फिर आप यहाँ पे एलिजिबल हो। और बाकी जो भी आपके डाउट्स होते हैं, सब कुछ यहाँ पे लिखा हुआ है, आप इसको चेक करोगे आपको सारा पता लग जाएगा। इंटरव्यू की बात करें तो देखो आपके तीन-चार राउंड यहाँ पे होएंगे। टेलीफोनिक स्क्रीनिंग होएगी, टेस्ट होता है, वर्चुअल राउंड, ओप्स क्लाइंट राउंड, ऐसे करके तीन-चार राउंड होते हैं। तो टेलीपरफॉर्मेंस के इंटरव्यू के ऊपर मैंने एक स्पेशल वीडियो पोडकास्ट किया हुआ है। उसमें इसके सारे राउंड्स के बारे में बताया है कि मतलब किस तरीके के क्वेश्चन आते हैं, कैसे जवाब देना होता है, कैसे क्लियर करना है। वो वीडियो आप देख लोगे पूरी तैयारी हो जाएगी। इसके अलावा गाइस, अगर आपका कोई भी डाउट है तो कमेंट बॉक्स आपके लिए ओपन है। ये वीडियो अगर आपको अच्छा लगा तो लाइक कर देना। ऐसी न्यू न्यू वीडियो के लिए इस चैनल को आप लोग सब्सक्राइब कर लेना। मिलेंगे दोबारा से जल्दी किसी और वीडियो के साथ। तब तक के लिए सभी को बेस्ट विशेस। गुड लक। जय हिंद।

title: The Billionaires Named In The Epstein Files
transcription: Forbes estimates Donald Trump is worth $6.2 billion due to his cryptocurrency ventures, his social media platform, Truth Social, and royalties on branded products. Most of the emails in the latest release of the files are unverified tips the public sent to the FBI about Trump's relationship to Epstein. But from previous releases, we can track their relationship back to the '90s and early 2000s. Flight logs show that Trump flew on Epstein's plane multiple times. And photos show Epstein attending events at Mar-a-Lago in 1992 and 2000. Trump has said that the relationship with Epstein soured years ago. He says he had no knowledge of Epstein's sex crimes. When The New York Times asked the White House for comment, it referred to this statement from the Department of Justice, that the files may include fake or falsely submitted images, documents, or videos. Richard Branson, worth $2.8 billion, founded the Virgin Group with major brands like Virgin Atlantic and Virgin Galactic, the space tourism company. His name appears hundreds of times in the files. In one email, he joked about Epstein bringing a harem, but Virgin later said that referred to Epstein's adult staff. And photos show Epstein visiting Branson's private island in the Caribbean. A spokesperson said that if Branson had known the full facts, he would never have become involved with Epstein. Sergey Brin, worth over $255 billion, co-founded Google. He communicated with Ghislaine Maxwell, Epstein's longtime associate, starting in 2003. The files include reports from people saying he visited Epstein's island multiple times. And these photos show him at a dinner for billionaires put on by the Epstein-funded Edge Foundation. Jeffrey also attended these dinners. Brin has not publicly commented on the documents. Steve Tisch, worth $1.6 billion, is a film producer and co-owner of the New York Giants. Emails show Epstein introducing Tisch to women and exchanging explicit commentary. In a comment, Tisch said, "We had a brief association where we exchanged emails about adult women and, in addition, we discussed movies, philanthropy, and investments." Elon Musk, the founder of Tesla, is worth a whopping $825 billion, making him the richest man on Earth as of early 2026. In the latest release of files, he's seen emailing Jeffrey Epstein in 2013 and also in 2012, asking what day/night will be the wildest party on your island.

title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ rescues Marvel after string of box office bombs
transcription:
That's a big rating from you, so I'm- I'm excited too, which is great. You know, Tom Holland, I love him as Spider-Man, too. So I'm looking forward to seeing that one. Next up we have I Want Your Sex. So Olivia Wilde's new comedy thriller, at least for now. Olivia Wilde's been putting out, like, some excellent films. What- what stands out, what- what makes this one tick?
Yeah, everyone thinks that this is going to be Christopher Nolan's summer with the Odyssey, you know, that whole thing. I think it's Olivia Wilde's summer. She directed and starred in a movie called The Invite a month or so ago, that I think very possibly she could get a double Oscar nomination for. Now she turns up in something completely different. It's called I Want Your Sex, directed by Gregg Araki. And it is the story of a provocative artist played by Olivia Wilde, who hires an intern played by Cooper Hoffman, who is Philip Seymour Hoffman's son in real life. And she treats him as, uh, as, uh, more than an intern. He becomes her muse, he becomes the person that she has a kind of casual, but very intense relationship that changes both their lives. And this is a movie that is a satire of the art world. There's a lot happening here, but it's really funny. And the reason that it works is because of the committed performances of Olivia Wilde and Cooper Hoffman, who both are put into some very uncomfortable situations here, but both of whom I think do a great job here. So I gave I Want Your Sex, now in theaters, four out of five stars.
Man, the versatility from Olivia Wilde, very, very impressive, isn't it? So we've got about a minute left, Richard, so- but we have Sheep in the Box, too. It follows an idea of AI replicas. You know, did this concept work? Did it not work? How do we feel?
Well, this is Japanese film now playing in North America and it's the story of a grieving couple who replaced their late child, their seven year old, with a robot. And then the robot's, rather than bring them together, the robot starts to have sort of ideas of his own. And you know, it's kind of a lovely made film. It looks great. But when you think back to movies like AI Artificial Intelligence, After Yang, or even Megan, we've seen this kind of thing before. So I gave Sheep in a Box, which is, or in the Box, now playing in theaters, two and a half stars out of five.
Okay, you know what, again, it's, you know, summer at the box office, isn't it, right? We've had Toy Story 5, now we've got Spider-Man. It's exciting, isn't it?
It is exciting. People are going back to the theaters in big, big numbers. Try and get a ticket for The Odyssey, still, and you're going to have a rough time, so I'm happy to see it.
I'm going to see it in 70 millimeter, in less than a couple of weeks, and it was very hard to do, but I'm still going to go. Richard Crouse, our- our film critic. Always appreciate it, Richard. Thank you.
See you soon.

title: BREAKING: Trump calls off MASSIVE Iran attack
transcription: Here's President Trump calling off a massive attack against Iran last night. The commander-in-chief says the change comes amid progress with the regime. Rebecca Castor is live in Washington with the details. Good morning, Rebecca. Good morning, Charlie. This was set to be one of the largest bombing campaigns against Iran to date, but now the President is signaling a peace deal could be close. He wrote on Truth Social, the USA is locked and loaded and ready to go against Iran. Despite this, we have just been asked by Iran and other Middle Eastern countries to hold off any attack, and that the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to. This would include the immediate complete and total opening of the Hormuz Strait, and an end to Iran's nuclear threat. I have agreed to cancel the attack subject to being able to rapidly make a deal. According to Axios, one of those Middle Eastern allies who asked President Trump to hold off on further strikes was the Saudi Crown Prince. The White House confirmed they spoke on the phone yesterday. And this comes after the US and Saudi Arabia launched joint strikes against Iranian militias in Iraq last week. But now the Saudis and other partners in the region are pushing the US and Iran to de-escalate. In an interview with Laura last night, Secretary of State Marco Rubio says it's because of President Trump that Tehran can no longer avoid consequences and may be ready to fold. I don't think the Iranian regime has ever faced a president like President Trump, which is someone that actually takes action. You know, they got used to for 20 or 30 years, not just the US, but the broader world allowing them to get away with things like lying, breaking deals, tricking people into agreements and so forth. The regime has to change. Their view is they don't want to just govern Iran, they want to govern the region. They view them- they want to export their revolution. That does have to change. And the only way you're going to change that is if you if you make the price of it too high for them to be able to pay. Qatari mediators held separate talks with US, Iranian, and Omani officials yesterday on reopening the strait. Axios reports those talks made progress. Charlie, Laura, and Griff, back to you. All right, Rebecca. Thank you, Rebecca. Overnight, President Trump pausing the strikes on Iran, revealing a rough outline for a deal. The President writing, "The immediate complete and total opening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to Iran's nuclear threat. I have agreed, for the future benefit of the world and likewise, the survival of a successful and prosperous Iran, to cancel the attack, subject to being able to rapidly make a deal." Joining us now is former National Security Council member, retired Vice Admiral Robert Harward. Uh thank you for joining us this morning. So, um, w- w- where do you think uh things stand right now? Obviously, we have heard, uh we've seen President Trump both uh bombing Iran and then uh holding out hope that we might get a deal. Where are you on that?

title: EA SPORTS FC 27 | Official Gameplay Deep Dive
transcription: More player control, more fluidity, and more changes led by you. There's so much that's new to gameplay this year. We addressed AI defending, reinvented corners, reworked attacking runs, dribbling under pressure, and fluid one-twos. And of course, retuned fundamentals to reduce intercept-backs, rebalance play styles, and deliver on more of the improvements you care about most. Let's dive in, starting with something you've called out over and over: AI defending. Your feedback is clear: manual defending should be the best way to stop your opponent. So we've tackled that from a number of angles this year, taking power away from the AI and giving it to you when you are defending. You'll feel the difference as soon as you take control. Your player will jockey more responsively. You'll also have a larger tackling range, a larger interception range, and a larger blocking range when defending manually. For example, the AI isn't quick enough to cut off the angle and can't quite reach to make the interception. But when you take control, that quicker jockey can get you into position and you're able to reach farther to win the ball. We've also minimized AI auto-tackles in competitive gameplay. The AI will still be able to win the ball if your opponent dribbles right into them, but they'll almost never lunge for the ball or reach into a challenge. And, we've loosened teammate contain and team press in the defensive third. The AI will still get into solid defensive positions, but taking manual control will give you more tools to stop your opponent. We've also reinvented corners to reduce luck and continue to reward skill. In FC 25, corners are split into two phases. One to prepare your pass and one that gives you creative control over your run. Pick your spot and power up your cross. Then, you'll have a few seconds to lose your marker so you can time your run to arrive at the perfect moment. This unlocks so much set-piece creativity, and equal amounts of set-piece chaos we see in leagues around the world. In attack, you'll have more control over how your

transcription: your teammates run off the ball. New creative runs completely reinvent how the attacking AI makes runs to give you options going forward. Just like top strikers around the world, your teammates will now curl along the back line and hold their runs, giving you more time to spot and pick a pass. These curved runs help your players find open space and avoid defenders that could slow their momentum. You can now trigger these curved runs, bending them around the back line to set up the perfect pass. You'll see more realistic movement from your teammates in authentic gameplay as well, not just with how they make runs, but also how they look, with more natural and composed animations. Look out for the gameplay deep dive and the Pitch Notes for all of the details on how we're driving realism in authentic gameplay. New off-balance dribbling is another way we've made gameplay more fluid. Elite dribblers will maintain control of the ball as they stumble and ride challenges. This was inspired by the likes of Pedri and Musiala, who find creative ways to keep the ball under control even as tackles fly in. We've also improved one-twos and quick passing sequences. Players maintain speed more effectively and accelerate more responsively. This happens at the animation level, making it feel like one fluid action to give you more freedom of movement after making a pass. Those tiny details have a huge impact on your experience, which is why we've really invested in gameplay fundamentals again this year. Here's what we've improved based on your feedback. Last year, we put a lot of time into helping you retain possession after winning the ball back. While we solved for a lot of situations, there was more work to be done, particularly after interceptions. To make that next step, we've fundamentally changed how defenders treat interceptions. Instead of prioritizing blocking the pass, players will now prioritize controlling the ball, yielding more consistent outcomes and helping you retain possession. Each shot type has been carefully tuned in FC 25 to shine where they would in a real match.

But yeah, I stayed in that job as kind of head of music overseeing the nine venues and the 25 staff for right up until COVID. Um. Just before COVID, things were definitely kind of ramping up in terms of my using. I was more and more so kind of going to work with no sleep and kind of just about functioning. The job itself, it's kind of interesting. Once now that I was kind of head of the department, I could almost kind of like not work as hard and hide it. Like, you know, you've when you're kind of doing the bookings, like booking the DJs or you're promoting the show, your work is visible, because, you know, if you don't book the DJ, there's no show. If you don't promote the show, there's not enough ticket sales. So, you can't really hide in that regard. But, my my kind of role now as kind of the head of the team was to more just oversee. Like, I would sign off programming ideas, I would sign off artwork, I would sign off marketing campaigns. I wouldn't actually be doing them myself, I'd just kind of be overseeing everything and kind of keeping the the wheels oiled. Um. And, I don't know if that necessarily suits me, like, kind of job. I feel like that I need that kind of creative input directly from myself to kind of give me that feeling of purpose. And, yeah, during this period, I was just not really enjoying my job, I was using a lot. I was using a lot at home. I had a flatmate, but I'd often just kind of come home and go into my bedroom and just use all night and go to work. It was pretty bleak. Um, COVID then came and all the venues closed. There was obviously lockdown, I got put on furlough. Um, not long after that, I had to furlough... Sorry, I had to make all of the staff redundant. So, to have to do that was really challenging mentally. Um. At the time, I was actually engaged to my ex and we were planning our wedding and we were also kind of saving for the future to like buy a house and stuff like that. And I remember asking my boss, "Do, you know, is there any chance that I'm going to be made redundant? You know, because I'm that's going to really put me in a difficult situation." transcription: పోతే రెస్పాన్సిబిలిటీస్ వచ్చేస్తాయి. అండ్ రెస్పాన్సిబిలిటీస్ తో పాటు మెచ్యూరిటీ వచ్చేస్తది. అంటే మనం కొంచం ఎల్డర్ పీపుల్ లా బిహేవ్ బిహేవ్ చేయడం స్టార్ట్ చేస్తాం. దాంట్లో మనం మర్చిపోతాం అన్నమాట. మనం ఏం చేయాలనుకున్నాం? మనం ఏం మనకి ఏమేం నచ్చుతాయో, అవి చేయడం మర్చిపోతాం బేసిగ్గా. నేను అనుకున్నది చేయకుండా, ఒక బ్యాక్ స్టెప్ వేసుకోకుండా, నేను అనుకున్నది చేస్తూ, రెస్పాన్సిబుల్ గా ఉంటూ అన్ని లైఫ్ ని బ్యాలెన్స్ చేసుకుంటూ వెళ్ళాలి అనుకుంటున్నా గాయ్స్. సో అది దాని పాయింట్ మీనింగ్. ఒకే. నెక్స్ట్ పాయింట్ వచ్చేసి న్యూ మొబైల్. ఫర్ 2026 అండ్ నేను కొత్త మొబైల్ ని తీసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నా. లైక్ దీంట్లో నేను టు ఆప్షన్స్ పెట్టుకున్నా. ఫస్ట్ ది వచ్చేసి గూగుల్ పిక్సెల్ లేదంటే ఐ ఫోన్, ఒకే. సో ఎందుకని అంటే బికాస్ అఫ్ కెమెరా. లాస్ట్ బట్ నాట్ ద లీస్ట్ ఎవరికి భయపడకుండా బతకాలి. ఎస్ సో అందరూ బేసిగ్గా భయపడుతూ బ్రతికేస్తారు అని చెప్పి నా ఒపీనియన్. బట్ ఎవరెమనుకుంటారు అని ఆలోచించకుండా బ్రతకాలి అన్నది ఇట్స్ లైక్ అ డ్రీం. భయపడకుండా ఎవరెమనుకుంటారు అన్న భయం లేకుండా నా లైఫ్ ని నేను లీడ్ చేయాలనుకుంటున్నా. సో దిస్ ఇస్ ద లాస్ట్ పాయింట్. అండ్ లాస్ట్ అండ్ ఫైనల్ గా నేను రాసుకున్నాను ఇక్కడ కింద ఒక నోట్ అన్నమాట. సో ఏం రాసుకున్నాను అంటే ఫైనల్లీ ఐ యామ్ మ్యానిఫెస్టింగ్ అ హెల్తీ అండ్ హ్యాపీ మెమొరబుల్ విత్ పీస్ 2026. అండ్ ఐ హోప్ దిస్ 2026 విల్ బి ద బెస్ట్ ఇయర్ అఫ్ మై లైఫ్. బికాస్ ఆబ్వియస్లి ఇట్ విల్ బి ద బెస్ట్ ఇయర్ అఫ్ మై లైఫ్ బికాస్ నేను ఆల్రెడీ నేను ఏమైతే చేయాలని అనుకుంటున్నానో అవన్నీ నేను ఆల్రెడీ స్టార్ట్ చేశాను, ఆల్మోస్ట్ స్టార్ట్ చేశాను. చేయడం స్టార్ట్ చేసాను నేను ఎట్లా ఉండాలి అనుకుంటున్నానో అట్లానే ఉండడం స్టార్ట్ చేసాను కాబట్టి ఇట్స్ ఆల్రెడీ ద బెస్ట్ ఇయర్ అఫ్ మై లైఫ్. అండ్ బట్ స్టిల్ ఇంకా హాఫ్ ఇయర్ మిగిలి ఉంది కాబట్టి ఐ విష్ అండ్ ఐ హోప్ ద రిమైనింగ్ సిక్స్ మంత్స్ అఫ్ దిస్ ఇయర్ విల్ బి ద సేమ్. దట్స్ ఇట్ వాట్ ఐ హావ్ రిటన్ ఇన్ మై డైరీ గాయ్స్ ఫర్ మై సెల్ఫ్. అండ్ మీరు కూడా ఎప్పుడైనా డైరీ రాసుకున్నారా? రాసుకుంటే ఏం రాసుకున్నారో కామెంట్ సెక్షన్ లో కామెంట్ చేయండి. ఈ వీడియో లాస్ట్ వరకు చూశారానంటే మీకు ఈ వీడియో లో ఏదో ఒకటి నచ్చే ఉంటుంది కదా. ఇఫ్ దిస్ వీడియో టచెస్ యువర్ హార్ట్ దెన్ డు లైక్, షేర్ అండ్ సబ్స్క్రైబ్. దట్స్ ఇట్ ఫర్ టుడే వచ్చే వీడియోలో మళ్ళీ కలుద్దాం అప్పటివరకు బాయ్ బాయ్.

title: Diary Entry Writing | Minor Discourse 2.1 | Class 10 SSC English | LMR
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: Hey everyone, and welcome. Today, we're going to crack one of the easiest questions in your English exam, a question that can absolutely guarantee you full marks if you just know the secret. I know how stressful exams can be, but what if I told you there's one question that's not a trap, but actually your secret weapon for getting those marks in the bag? That's right, we are talking about the diary entry. Seriously, this can be the easiest question on the entire paper, but only if you know the simple formula that combines a little bit of format with a whole lot of feelings. So, what exactly is the diary entry? Well, think of it like you're just talking to yourself on paper. It's all about pouring out your personal feelings and what you've experienced. And because it's personal, it's always written in the first person, you know, using words like I, me and my. Okay, you ready for this? Let's dive into what I call the golden formula. It's like a simple, unbreakable code for success that's going to get you easy marks right from the start. All you have to do is memorize these five letters: D, D, T, S, B. That's it. It stands for Date, Day, Time, Salutation, and Body. This structure is your key. I mean, you'll literally be scoring points before you've even written a proper sentence. Okay, so let's break down that first part, the format. And honestly, this is where you're going to get the easiest marks in your entire exam. It is just this simple. At the top left of your page, you write the date, the day and the time, just like you see here. That's it. Boom. Instant marks in your pocket. The salutation is just as easy. You always, and I mean always, start with Dear Diary, followed by a comma. Don't try to get creative here. This is the way. All right, with the format locked in, let's move on to the most important part, the body. This is where you actually tell your story, and it's where your feelings are going to earn you the big marks. Now, you don't need to write a whole novel here. Just keep it short and focused. Two or three paragraphs is perfect. And in those paragraphs, you just need to do three things: describe what happened, express how you felt about it, and explain your reaction. And here it is, the most crucial point of all: you have to use emotional words, words like happy, sad, excited, nervous, proud. This is what separates a pretty good answer from a perfect, full-marks answer. So remember this: feelings equal full marks. Okay, enough talk. Let's actually put this all together. We're going to build a perfect, full-marks entry step-by-step, and you'll see just how simple this is.

category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: First things first, we lay down the foundation, the perfect format. We put the date, day, and time on the top left, and then follow it up with Dear Diary. Just by doing this, you've already started scoring. Next up, the first paragraph. We describe the event, getting exam results, and then we immediately inject those feelings. See those words, happiest and very nervous? That is exactly what the examiner is looking for. That's the gold. And here's the whole shebang. We added a second paragraph describing the reaction of others and how it made us feel, and then we just cap it off with a simple, natural ending, something like, it was truly a memorable day. title: How to Bullet Journal in 2026 (Every New Technique)

transcription: Once you do, the cycle begins again. Record what happens, reflect on it, refine, respond. Instead of defaulting to outsourcing our critical thinking, our agency, our emotional regulation to the whims of the algorithm, Bujo encourages insourcing, to be ever more self-reliant and self-aware. It's the practice of coming back to yourself over and over again that helps you develop the skills, capacity, and compassion that you need to author the life you actually want to live. It's the practice in learning how to trust yourself. The real magic happens when you use the system day after day, week after week. And that's where most of us need support. If you want to learn how to bullet journal this year and make it stick, check out the Bullet Journal Foundation Plan. We'll provide you with everything that you need to move from a basic setup to mastering a personal operating system for writing a better life. You'll have access to hours of exclusive tutorial videos, content, and a supportive and inspirational life writing community from around the world. If that's interesting, click the link below or scan this QR code to get started. When I launched Bullet Journal, there were three core bullets that gave Bujo its name: tasks, events, and notes. These were focused on mindful productivity, getting clear on why you're doing what you're doing. Though the what and the why remain central to Bujo, I've added a new dimension that I think is key: the how. How are you doing? In other words, what are you feeling as you're doing? For some, this may seem like a strange addition, but how you feel impacts everything that you do. When we don't know what we're feeling or how to define it, it becomes really hard to meet our own needs. This is why I introduced the mood bullet. The mood bullet is represented by the equal sign. It's for capturing both physical and emotional patterns. So mood could be angry or it could be heavy, tired. The mood bullet builds on a powerful therapeutic technique known as affect labeling, a modern name for an ancient practice of simply naming our feelings. Giving our feelings a name helps us better understand, regulate, and represent ourselves. That said, finding the right word is not always easy. We either lack the awareness or the vocabulary or both. I know I did. I used to feel good or bad or meh.

transcription: That didn't give me much to work with. The mood bullet gives us a simple way to develop our emotional vocabulary and our awareness. In addition to the mood bullet, I also changed the name of the task bullet to action. The main reason why is because tasks feel like a burden. This is a list of things that we have to do or should do. The word action reminds me of my agency. Each action is an experience waiting to be born. I only get to experience the life that I want through action. So now the four core bullets are notes, actions, moods, and events or NAME. The acronym is a reminder of a core part of our practice, observing our experience, which brings us to the next big addition, rituals. The Bullet Journal method features daily, weekly, and monthly logs. Each uses a simple template that helps you organize that period of time. At first glance, these don't look all that different from more generic checklists or calendars, but there is a lot more going on there than meets the eye. Each log is an invitation to pause and study our lived experience, to see what is true for us, alive for us in the moment. In other words, to reflect on our lives. One of the biggest questions we get is how. What exactly are you supposed to do? There are, after all, countless ways to reflect. So I created a reflection ritual specifically designed for BuJo. I call it TAME. TAME provides a simple and structured reflection framework in these steps. One, tidy your record to make it current and to jog your memory. Two, acknowledge which actions moved you toward or away from your intentions. Three, migrate actions that support your intentions and goals with care. Four, enact. Literally to make things real through prioritized action. By running these reflection rituals, you can reflect on the past, refine your future plans and actions, and as a result, be more present. This layered approach also helps prevent anything from falling through the cracks, no matter how little life cares about your plans. I see every notebook as another chapter in the story of my life. This is part of the reason why I like to start each year with a new notebook.

title: Diary Entry Writing for Class 7 | Full Explanation
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: Hello my dear students, aaj hamari English ki class mein rehne wali hai diary entry. Diary entry kya hoti hai? Diary entry hoti hai jo bhi aapke sath poore din mein vyateet ho chuka hai, usey aap ek diary mein likhein pratidin, aur ek format ke sath. Usey kehte hain diary entry. Toh aajiye aaj hum iska format samjhenge jo ki diary entry ko sahi tarike se likhne ka dhang hota hai aur isse aap exam mein full marks paa sakte hain. Aajiye format padhne ke liye. Date, Date jis din aap apni diary entry ko likh rahe hain, usi din ki yahan pe date daal denge. Uske baad day, aap isse milaan karke rakhiye, check karke rakhiye ki is din jo bhi date hai usi ka day hona chahiye. Time, jis samay aap likh rahe hain, woh time likhenge is par, jaise ki 9:00 baje abhi aur is par p.m. aur a.m. lagana mat bhoolna, jaise shaam ko likh rahe ho toh p.m. laga dena, subah likh rahe ho, subah ke samay mein toh a.m. laga dena. Uske baad aayega apna line space, line space aap exam sheet jo aapki rehne wali hai usme line space mat likhna L.S. karke, kyunki ispe aapke number cut sakte hain, teacher samjhega pata nahi kya bawal cheez likh di isne. Aap is jagah ek line chorr doge, maine aapko samjhane ke liye yahan pe L.S. likh diya hai aur line space, isliye aap ek line chorr dena single. Uske baad aap daaloge, Dear Diary, pyaari diary, aapki diary hai toh pyaari hi rehne wali hai. Uske baad aayegi hamari heading, heading jaisa aapka question rahega us hisab se aap apni heading daal denge isme. Phir aa jata hai hamara content, content bhi question ke hi... question se hi nikala jata hai content, jaisa ki aapko question diya gaya hai usi hisab se aap apna content likhenge. Content mein hamesha I ka use hota hai, woh ki aati hai first person mein, first person I ka use karoge aap hamesha content, kyunki aapki diary hai, aap khud likh rahe ho, kisi aur se toh likhvaoge nahi, khud likh rahe ho toh I ka use karoge diary mein toh I ka use karna hota hai. Uske baad aa jata hai, isme tense ka kaunsa use karna hai? Isme tense use hota hai past indefinite, aap poochoge ab ki past indefinite kyun hota hai? Past indefinite isliye hota hai kyunki aap jo diary mein likh rahe ho, woh pehle beet chuka hai, aapke sath woh ho chuka hai woh likhoge aap.

transcription: यह नहीं है कि अभी हो रहा है वह लिखते जा रहे हैं, जो होगा वह लिखे जा रहे हैं। क्योंकि फ्यूचर का कुछ किसी को पता नहीं है। फ्यूचर में क्या होने वाला है वह तो आप लिख नहीं सकते हो। अभी चल रहा है वह भी नहीं लिख रहे हो। जो बीत चूका है, वह लिख रहे हो। इसलिए आप पास्ट इंडेफिनेट का यूज़ करेंगे। और आपको जैसे कि सेंटेंस नहीं बनाना आते हैं, तो यह पास्ट इंडेफिनेट का यह फार्मूला है। इससे आप छोटे-छोटे सेंटेंस बनाकर कार्यवाही कर सकते हैं अपनी डायरी एंट्री में। अब इसे भी समझ लेते हैं। सब्जेक्ट प्लस वर्ब की सेकंड फॉर्म। वर्ब की यह तीन जो फॉर्म होती हैं, इन्हें आप बिल्कुल अच्छे से रट लीजिये अपनी ग्रामर की बुक में से। यह आगे चलकर बहुत ही काम में आने वाली हैं। हर एक चीज़ में काम में आती है यह वर्ब की फॉर्म तो। उसके बाद आप कोई भी ऑब्जेक्ट। जैसा कि आपको एक सेंटेंस बनाना है, तो आप उस हिसाब से सब्जेक्ट, वर्ब की सेकंड फॉर्म और ऑब्जेक्ट लगा सकते हैं। उसके बाद आपको यहां पे बिना लाइन स्पेस दिए हुए नेम लिखना है। नेम आपका जो भी रहेगा, आप अपना नेम लिख दोगे इसमें। उसके बाद सिग्नेचर करने होते हैं डायरी एंट्री में जो की ऑप्शनल हैं। सीबीएसई वाले कहते हैं, कुछ सीबीएसई वाले कहते हैं कि करो, कुछ कहते हैं मत करो। तो इस लिए आप अपने जो भी आपके इनविजिलेटर रहने वाले हैं, उनसे आप पूछ लीजिए कि इसमें हम अपने सिग्नेचर करें या ना करें। यह ऑप्शनल रहते हैं, ठीक है? तो आपको, आई होप दैट, आपको फॉर्मेट आज समझ में आ गया होगा और मैं अगली क्लास में आपके लिए क्वेश्चन लाने की प्रयास करूंगा कुछ। तो आप एक और स्क्रीनशॉट या जो भी आपको करना है, आप कर लीजिए। और एक और हां चीज़ कि यह वाली चीज़ है ना, यह दूसरा पेज, यह बिल्कुल इसके नीचे आएगा। मेरे पास जगह नहीं थी, इस वजह से मैंने इसे यहां पर लगा दिया है। ठीक है? तो आप इस वाले को जो भी हेडिंग से लेकर सिग्नेचर तक रहने वाला है, वह यहां से नीचे की साइड लिखेंगे, ठीक है? ऐसा मत करना कि इधर ही कर दो। नहीं नहीं, इसे नीचे निकाल देना, ठीक है? तो आई होप दैट आपको समझ में आ गया होगा तो आप एक बार स्क्रीनशॉट ले लीजिए इस फॉर्मेट का जो भी आपके काम आएगा।

title: Are You Happy?
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: And now I don't need a perfect 10. I don't need a clean escape. I just need a reason not to hate the person that I became. If something can be lifted, it can be taken away. And every time I let myself believe, that's exactly what it does to me. Are you happy? I don't chase that word. Every time I get close to it, I lose what I've learned, I'm trying not to fall apart on the ground beneath my feet, not flying, not rising, just trying not to sink. I'm not searching for happy. I don't think it's for me. I'm just looking for a moment where the hurt lets me breathe. Happiness feels like a wave, you don't see it coming. Peace feels like something other people are holding. I don't need the rush, I don't need the high, I just need something that stays when I'm done asking why. I don't want the answer. I don't need it to make sense. I just want the noise to stop for 60 seconds. So if you ask me are you happy, I'll probably look away. Not because I'm hiding, I just don't know what to say. I've made room for the sadness, but it still spills out. I try to sit with the silence, but it gets loud. I'm not searching for happy. I don't know what that means. I'm just trying to keep breathing through memories I can't leave. I don't need perfect days. I don't need control. I just want to stop feeling broken everywhere I go. I'm still here even now, still standing, still somehow. I don't know peace, I just know I'm trying, and that has to count for something. Mmm. Mmm. Mmm. Mmm.

title: Dax - I Fell, But Heaven Held Me ( Lyrics Video )
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: I fell longer than the light of day, but right at my lowest when I gave up control, something bigger than me didn't let me fall. When I thought I was done, when I thought I'd break, when the weight of my soul was too much to take, there was something I felt through the pain. I fell, but Heaven held me when I couldn't stand on my own. I was lost in the valley, but I was never alone. Through the cracks and the chaos, through the hurt I couldn't see, I fell, but Heaven held me. Maybe the fall's part of the plan. Maybe the breaking made me who I am. Maybe the silence was Heaven's way of teaching my heart how to trust and stay. I didn't see it then, but now I know, even in darkness, I wasn't alone. Every step, every scar, every plea was leading me back to what saved me. I fell, but Heaven held me, even when I couldn't believe. When my faith was fading, You still didn't leave. Through the tears and the trembling, You were carrying me. I fell, but Heaven held me. Yeah. I fell, but I'm still here. So that means Heaven never let me go.

title: Unexpected Clarity  A Prison Memoir of Mental Liberation #journeeman #prisonlife #mindfulness
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription:
I've got something to say,
something that sticks in my throat like iron.
I miss my prison cell.
Not the wires, not the count, not the smell of bleach and sweat and locked metal.
I don't miss West Wing tier,
I don't miss Seg unit,
I don't miss cell 68.
I love my wife, my kids, my desk, the open sky when I step outside.
If you handed me the keys tomorrow and said 'Go back,' I'd burn them.
But listen,
there's a part of me that still walks those three meters by two and a half,
that still feels the quiet drop when the unit locks down.

Picture it.
Green door, heavy bolt,
grey vinyl-covered cabin wood,
tiny desk, bench that bites your spine, bed thinner than regret, toilet right there, no hiding.
Sink, small curtain with its ten-centimeter rule so they can always see you breathing.
Church guitar leaning against the wall like it's waiting for permission to sing, that's it.
That's the whole kingdom. And yet, when the day died and the televisions faded to mumbles, some footsteps echoed and then stopped, that box became still.
No notifications,
no opinions screaming from screens, 
no endless choices pretending to be freedom,
just me
and my mind.
They controlled everything else.

Time,
light,
movement,
who I spoke to,
when I ate,
when I pissed. Razor wire outside, laughing at the sky. But the mind, they couldn't touch it.
In that cage, my thoughts got room to stretch, to roam, to question everything I ever preached from a pulpit, to sit with doubt instead of burying it under sermons. Meditation wasn't an effort, it just happened like breathing,
like the fan humming, low light when the heat creeping through the pipe, a summer sweat turning the air to soup. I'd joke with the boys heading back to my chalet, make them laugh, 'it's a bloody cell, Malcolm.' Yeah, I'd say.
But tonight, it's my university.

title: আপনার  জীবনে কী কী পরিবর্তন আসবে জানুন #ThirdEye #AjnaChakra
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: আপনার মাথার ভিতরে এমন একটা অঙ্গ আছে, যেটা জাগ্রত হলে আপনি এমন কিছু দেখতে পাবেন যেটা সাধারণ মানুষ দেখতে পায় না। আপনি মানুষের মন বুঝতে পারবেন, ভবিষ্যতের ঘটনাও আগে থেকে টের পেয়ে যেতে পারেন এবং আপনার বুদ্ধিমত্তাও বাড়বে। ঋষিরা একথাই বলে গেছেন। আর এ অঙ্গটির নাম হলো আজ্ঞা চক্র। যাকে আমরা সাধারণ কথায় বলি তৃতীয় নয়ন, তৃতীয় চক্ষু বা ইংরেজিতে Third eye। কিন্তু বিজ্ঞান, বিজ্ঞানও কিন্তু এটাকে স্বীকার করছে এবং বলছে যে এই Third eye আসলে হলো পিনিয়াল গ্ল্যান্ড। কিন্তু যদি এই Third eye জাগ্রত হয়, তৃতীয় চক্ষু যদি খুলে যায়, তাহলে কি সত্যিই আপনি কোনো অলৌকিক বা বিশেষ ক্ষমতা পাবেন? জানতে হলে ভিডিওটা একেবারে শেষ পর্যন্ত দেখুন। কেননা এই ভিডিওটা দেখার পর আপনার জীবনকে দেখার, জীবনকে চেনার যে নজর সেটা হয়তো বদলে যাবে। চলুন আগে একটু বিজ্ঞান কি বলছে জেনে নিই। আমাদের দুটো ভুরুর ঠিক মাঝখানে সোজা ভিতরের দিকে মস্তিষ্কের কেন্দ্রবিন্দুতে একটা ছোট গ্রন্থি আছে। একে বলা হয় পিনিয়াল গ্ল্যান্ড। আপনারা নিশ্চয়ই জানেন যারা দীক্ষিত তারা নিশ্চয়ই ধ্যান করেন এবং তখন গুরুদেব কি বলে দেন, দুই চোখের মাঝখানে দৃষ্টিটা ভিতর থেকে নিবদ্ধ রাখতে। কেন বলেন? কারণ ওখানে আছে আমাদের তৃতীয় চক্ষু যাকে আমরা বলি আজ্ঞা চক্র। আমরা আমাদের শরীরে সাতটা চক্রের কথা জানি। যার মধ্যে মাথার একেবারে উপরে যেটা সহস্রার আর যেটা কপালে দুই ভুরুর মাঝখানে সেটা হলো আজ্ঞা চক্র। বাকিগুলো নিয়ে আমি অন্য সময় আপনাদের সঙ্গে আলোচনা করব, বলবো সেই কথাগুলো। এখন দেখুন মানুষের পিনিয়াল গ্ল্যান্ড মাথার ভিতরে থাকে

transcription: এতে কিন্তু চোখের মতো কোনো কর্নিয়া, লেন্স বা রেটিনা এইসব কিছু থাকে না। এটা চোখের রেটিনা থেকে স্নায়ুর মাধ্যমে আলোর সংকেত গ্রহণ করে। কিন্তু শুনলে অবাক হয়ে যাবেন, এই অঙ্গটা যেটাকে আমরা বলছি পিনিয়াল গ্ল্যান্ড বিজ্ঞানের ভাষায়, এটা আমাদের শরীরে মেলাটোনিন এবং ডিএমটি নামক এমন কিছু কেমিক্যাল রিলিজ করে যা আমাদের চেতনা বা কনশাসনেসকে একটা ধাক্কায় অন্য মাত্রায় নিয়ে যেতে পারে। কিন্তু একটা বিষয় আপনাদের বলা দরকার। আমরা যদি আজ্ঞাচক্রকে জাগ্রত করতে পারি, অ্যাক্টিভ করতে পারি, অর্থাৎ আমাদের তৃতীয় নয়ন জাগ্রত হয়, তাহলে কি হবে? আপনি কি কোনো বিশেষ ক্ষমতা পাবেন? বলবো। একটু ধৈর্য ধরে শুনুন। প্রথম যেটা হলো, দা পাওয়ার অব ইনটুইশন। যেটাকে বলা হয় সিক্সথ সেন্স। বাংলায় ষষ্ঠ ইন্দ্রিয়। আপনার ষষ্ঠ ইন্দ্রিয় এতটা শক্তিশালী হয়ে উঠবে যে, আপনার সঙ্গে ভালো বা খারাপ যা-ই ঘটুক না কেন, আপনার মন আপনাকে সিগন্যাল দেবে। আপনি বুঝতে পারবেন কোনো জায়গায় গেলে সেখানে পজিটিভ শক্তি আছে নাকি নেগেটিভ শক্তি। এমনকি কেউ যদি মিষ্টি কথা বলে আপনার মন ভেজাতে চায় অথচ মনে মনে ক্ষতি চায়, তার আসল রূপটাও কিন্তু আপনি বুঝে যেতে পারবেন। সবটাই হবে আপনার মনের সাহায্যে। আপনার মন চিনিয়ে দেবে। আপনার চেতনা আপনাকে বুঝিয়ে দেবে। আপনাকে সামনে এসে কেউ কিন্তু বলবে না। দ্বিতীয় যেটা, সেটা হচ্ছে দা ল অফ অ্যাট্রাকশন মাস্টার। দেখুন, সাধারণ মানুষ কোনো জিনিস পাওয়ার জন্য যেটার প্রতি তার আগ্রহ থাকে, চায়, সেটার জন্য কঠোর পরিশ্রম করে। কিন্তু কঠোর পরিশ্রম করেও অনেকে অনেক সময় পায় না। কিন্তু যদি আজ্ঞাচক্র জাগ্রত হয়ে যায়, সে মনে মনে যা কল্পনা করে এবং সে মতো কাজ করে, তাহলে ইউনিভার্স বা প্রকৃতি সেই জিনিসটাকে চুম্বকের মতো টেনে নিয়ে আসে। সেটা পেয়ে যায় সে। মনের গভীর অদম্য ইচ্ছা আপনাকে সেই জিনিসটা এনে দেবে। অর্থাৎ যাদের

transcription: এই ষষ্ঠ ইন্দ্রিয় আজ্ঞাচক্র জাগ্রত হয়েছে তাদের ইচ্ছাশক্তি বা ম্যানিফেস্টেশন পাওয়ার অনেক বেশি তীব্র হয়। ফিউচার ভিশন। আলবার্ট আইনস্টাইন বা নিকোলা টেসলার মত জিনিয়াসদের নাম আপনারা শুনেছেন। খাতায় কলমে কোনো কিছু হিসেব-নিকেশ করার আগেই তাদের মাথায় কিন্তু পুরো আবিষ্কারটা দেখে ফেলতে পারতেন। টেসলা কিন্তু নিজেই স্বীকার করেছিলেন তিনি তাঁর মনের চোখ বা থার্ড আই দিয়ে ল্যাবরেটরির মেশিন সচল অবস্থায় দেখতে পেতেন। এটাই হলো তীব্র সৃজনশীলতা। অর্থাৎ আপনার তৃতীয় চক্ষু জাগ্রত হলে আপনার মধ্যে সৃজনশীলতা অনেক গুণ বেড়ে যাবে। আর মানসিক ডিপ্রেশন থেকে মুক্তি, ভয় থেকে মুক্তি, কনফিউশন বা দ্বিধা চিরকালের জন্য হারিয়ে যাবে। জীবনের যেকোনো পরিস্থিতিতে যত কঠিনই হোক না কেন সেই পরিস্থিতি আপনি শান্ত থাকতে পারবেন, সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবেন সেই পরিস্থিতিতেও। বুঝতে পারছেন? যদি এই থার্ড আই জাগ্রত হয় আপনি কিন্তু একটা নতুন মানুষে পরিণত হয়ে যাবেন। কিভাবে এই থার্ড আই জাগ্রত করবেন? বলব। একই সঙ্গে বলব গুরুর অধীনে না থেকে আমি পরবর্তী সময়ে যে ধ্যান গুলোর কথা বলব সেগুলো চেষ্টা করবেন না। কেন করবেন না? কেননা এই ধ্যান করার সময় আপনার মাথার মধ্যে কপালের দুই ভ্রুর মাঝখানে একটা ঘূর্ণন সৃষ্টি হবে প্রবল। তার সঙ্গে প্রবল উত্তাপ সৃষ্টি হবে আর সেই উত্তাপটা মনে হবে যেন সহস্রার ভেদ করে উপরের দিকে চলে যাচ্ছে। অর্থাৎ ব্রহ্মতালু ভেদ করে চলে যাচ্ছে। সহ্য করতে পারবে না যাদের সেই ক্ষমতা নেই তারা সহ্য করতে পারবেন না। সেই কারনেই আমার গুরুদেবও ব্যক্তিগতভাবে নিজে থেকে এই ধরনের ধ্যান করার কথা সাবধান করে দিয়েছিলেন আগে থেকেও। কাজেই এই কথাটা মনে রাখবেন আর পরবর্তী ভিডিওতে আমি আপনাদের বুঝিয়ে দেব কিভাবে থার্ড আই জাগ্রত করা সম্ভব এবং এর ফলে আপনি আরো কি কি পেতে পারেন। সঙ্গে থাকুন, ভালো থাকুন। দেখা হবে পরের ভিডিওতে।

title: David Wilcock’s Last Words REVEALED: UFO Expert’s 911 Call EXPOSES Hidden Struggle Before Death
category: Mental Health Vlogs & Personal Video Diaries
transcription: The final moments of David Wilcock are now coming into focus, and they paint a deeply troubling picture. According to reports from TMZ, Wilcock made a 911 call on Monday morning, just hours before his death. During that call, he spoke about serious financial problems and ongoing health issues. At one point, he told dispatch, quote, "I need to leave, I will be to the left of the house." Authorities say he refused to clarify whether he was armed or planning to harm himself. Dispatchers, meanwhile, treated the situation as urgent. In audio obtained by TMZ, officers can be heard describing the situation in real time, labeling it a potential suicide. Moments later, the situation escalated. As deputies arrived at his Colorado home, they approached with caution. The threat level was unclear, and backup was called in. Just before officers reached him, Wilcock said something else, quote, "I'm sorry to put you through this." And then, he hung up. Seconds later, deputies saw him outside the residence with a gun to his head. They took cover immediately, issuing commands to drop the weapon. But then, a single gunshot rang out. Authorities say Wilcock shot himself in front of responding deputies. No one else was found on the property after a search. He was pronounced dead at the scene. He was 53. Now, with details from that final call emerging, the tragedy surrounding David Wilcock is being seen in a new light, one shaped by personal struggles that remained largely hidden until the very end.

transcription: दोस्तों, परिस्थितियां सबके लिए एक जैसी नहीं होती और दूसरी बात यह कि प्रकृति से ज्यादा ताकतवर कुछ नहीं होता। यह बात असम के मामले में बिल्कुल सही साबित होती हुई दिखाई दे रही है। 12 से ज्यादा जिले प्रभावित हैं, 70 के आसपास मौतें हो चुकी हैं और 7 लाख से ज्यादा लोग उस असम में बाढ़ से परेशान हैं और अभी भी कई जानों की जाने का डर बना हुआ है और वहां के मुख्यमंत्री तक ने यह कह दिया है कि यह बड़ी चिंता की बात है। इतनी तेजी से बाढ़ पहले असम में नहीं आई थी। तो आखिर असम में इस तरह से बाढ़ अचानक से क्यों आ गई? तेजी से पानी कैसे भर गया? क्या मानसून जो कि बारिश का मौसम चल रहा है, इस वजह से हुआ है? तो क्या सिर्फ बाढ़ आने की जिम्मेदारी पूरी मानसून के ऊपर है या हमारा, आपका या हम जैसे कुछ लोगों का दोष है? चलिए सारी बातों को समझते हैं इस वीडियो में लेकिन सबसे पहले एक जरूरी जानकारी कि आपके लिए एक स्पेशल कोर्स आ चुका है IAS GS फाउंडेशन कोर्स। इस कोर्स की खास बात यह है कि अगर आप दिल्ली से या नोएडा से दृष्टि आईएएस की क्लास नहीं कर सकते और आप यही वाली क्लास ऑनलाइन करना चाहते हैं तो IAS GS फाउंडेशन लाइव ऑनलाइन कोर्स है। अब इस कोर्स की खास बात यह है कि 3 साल तक इस कोर्स की वैलिडिटी रहेगी। आप जितनी बार चाहें क्लास को उतनी बार देखिए। स्टडी मटेरियल हार्ड कॉपी में आपके घर पहुंचाया जाएगा तो आपको पढ़ने में भी मजा आएगा और इसके साथ ही आपको टेस्ट सीरीज प्रिलिम्स और मेंस की मिलेंगे और उसके साथ ही आंसर राइटिंग की प्रैक्टिस भी कराई जाएगी। इस वजह से यह आपके लिए बड़ा ही फायदेमंद है क्योंकि बेसिक से एडवांस तक सरल भाषा में आपको पूरा GS पढ़ाया जाएगा। आपको इसके बारे में अतिरिक्त जानकारी चाहिए तो वीडियो के डिस्क्रिप्शन में लिंक है, उसे क्लिक कर लीजिए या सीधे हमें कॉल कीजिए 87501 87501 पर। अब आते हैं हमारे टॉपिक पर। यहां पर सबसे पहली बात हम खबर को समझते हैं कि क्या है। देखिए, 66 से ज्यादा मौतें हो चुकी हैं, आंकड़े बढ़ते जा रहे हैं, 7 लाख लोग प्रभावित हैं, 856 गांव जो कि 12 जिलों के हैं वो प्रभावित हैं और 50,000 से ज्यादा लोग अभी राहत से वंचित हैं यानी कि वहां तक अभी भारत की सरकार या हम कहें असम की सरकार, सेना नहीं पहुंच पा रही है तो वह अभी इंतजार में हैं, ऐसे लोग भी हैं और इसके साथ ही असम राज्य आपदा प्रबंधन प्राधिकरण के अनुसार अभी और ज्यादा मुश्किल आने की इस डर बना हुआ है। अब अगली बात आती है कि ये सारी चीजें कैसे शुरू हुई? तो 19 जून को बाढ़ का पानी तेजी से खतरनाक स्तर पर पहुंचता है और जब वो खतरनाक स्तर पर पहुंचता है तो वो आसपास के इलाकों में बहना शुरू होता है और जिससे तीन सबसे ज्यादा शिवसागर, चराईदेव और जोरहाट, ये असम के ऐसे ऊपरी जिले हैं जहां पे सबसे पहले पानी बढ़ता है। क्यों? क्योंकि पानी ऊपर से ही नीचे आ रहा था तो जो ऊपर के जिले हैं वो प्रभावित होंगे और शिवसागर एक बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण शहर है जो पानी के चपेट में यानी कि बाढ़ के चपेट में आया। कई लोग राहत शिविर में हैं, बहुत सारे काम चल रहे हैं लेकिन मैंने क्या कहा, इंसान प्रकृति के आगे एक छोटा सा खिलौना मात्र है, उससे ज्यादा कुछ नहीं।
